content: Create a 30-second uninterrupted cinematic one-shot using Seedance 2.5. An experienced detective in their thirtiesexits a neon-lit subway station into a futuristic Tokyo street at night. The camera follows from behind before smoothly orbiting to reveal the detective's face, then continues tracking through a bustling market filled with holographic advertisements. Maintain consistent character appearance throughout the entire shot. Rain falls naturally, reflections shimmer across wet pavement, clothing and hair react realistically to the environment, and the detective briefly interacts with a holographic device. End with the detective stopping beneath a glowing sign as the camera cranes upward to reveal the cyberpunk skyline. Ultra-realistic, Hollywood cinematography, stable continuous shot, physically accurate lighting, premium film quality, no cuts or scene transitions.

La cámara lo sigue desde atrás antes de orbitar suavemente para revelar el rostro del detective; luego continúa siguiendo su recorrido a través de un mercado bullicioso lleno de anuncios holográficos.
